testsuite.name: SPEC0225 native journal profile — no public-loop or global credit

testcase.name: preserves JSON value/type/bytes via write/get/re-reserve in three fresh OS processes
requires identical bytes for idempotent confirmation and refuses conflicting value or attempt
inspects legacy JSON null separately from SQL NULL but never adopts a legacy reservation
refuses a default journal on the activated principal without an implicit opt-in
keeps old credential SELECT denied42501 after activation
qualifies only committed native get, preserving null without stamping confirm or reserve
never qualifies own uncommitted journal output or commits the caller transaction
refuses isolated public-grant before admission and accepts its exact restoration
refuses isolated membership before admission and accepts its exact restoration
refuses isolated checksum before admission and accepts its exact restoration
refuses isolated disabled-trigger before admission and accepts its exact restoration
refuses isolated inherit before admission and accepts its exact restoration
refuses isolated createdb before admission and accepts its exact restoration
refuses isolated createrole before admission and accepts its exact restoration
refuses isolated bypassrls before admission and accepts its exact restoration
refuses isolated replication before admission and accepts its exact restoration
rejects an old live login session without granting it journal access
never treats forged GUC or application name as an activated principal
refuses direct version0 insertion by the activated service principal
refuses version1 from another login even with INSERT and correct tenant
preserves durable state and primary error for before-update
preserves durable state and primary error for after-update
preserves durable state and primary error for before-commit
preserves durable state and primary error for commit-ack-loss
leaves an over-cap confirmation unconfirmed and blocks unsafe repeat reservation
refuses the activated default worker at its native preflight before downstream admission
